integrations.extensionText: Adds applications automatically when you apply on any of 26 job boards and updates statuses when you open “My applications” on hh.ru, LinkedIn, Habr Career or Indeed. It never needs your board passwords.
integrations.step1: Install the heyreply extension for Chrome or Firefox.
integrations.step2: Create a token here and paste it into the extension together with this site’s address.
integrations.step3: Apply as usual — applications appear on their own. Open “My applications” on the board now and then to pull in status changes.
integrations.createdText: Copy it now — it is shown only once. Treat it like a password: it lets anyone add applications to your account.
integrations.revokeText: The extension using this token stops adding applications immediately.
integrations.atsHint: ATS are the systems companies use to take applications on their own sites. When you click “Apply on company website” on LinkedIn or a careers page, the application usually lands in Greenhouse, Lever, Workable or Ashby.

emailImport.title: E-mail import
emailImport.text: Job boards e-mail you when you apply, when your application is viewed, and about invitations and rejections. Auto-forward those e-mails to your personal address and applications and statuses appear on their own — including ones sent from your phone.
emailImport.disabled: E-mail import is not configured on this server. An administrator needs to set INBOUND_EMAIL_DOMAIN and INBOUND_SECRET and deploy the Cloudflare Email Worker.
emailImport.addressHint: The address is random and known only to you. Mail to it is accepted only if it really comes from a job board (DKIM signature is checked).
emailImport.confirmText: Your mail provider ({from}) sent a confirmation request to this address. Enter the code in its forwarding settings or open the link.
emailImport.gmail_1: Gmail → Settings → “Forwarding and POP/IMAP” → “Add a forwarding address” → paste {address}.
emailImport.gmail_2: Gmail sends a confirmation code — it shows up here within seconds. Enter it in Gmail.
emailImport.gmail_3: Create a filter: paste the query below into “From” → “Create filter” → “Forward it to” {address}.
emailImport.gmail_4: Don’t forward all your mail — the job-board filter is enough.
emailImport.yandex_2: Condition: “From” contains a job-board domain (one rule per domain below, or one rule with several “or” conditions).
emailImport.yandex_4: Yandex asks to confirm forwarding — the link will appear here.
emailImport.mailru_2: Condition: “From” contains a job-board domain from the list below.
emailImport.mailru_4: Mail.ru asks to confirm the address — the link or code will appear here.
emailImport.autoForwardOnly: Use automatic forwarding (a filter). Forwarding by hand with the “Forward” button strips the board’s signature and the e-mail will be refused.
emailImport.kind_unverified_hint: The e-mail is not signed by the job board (DKIM) — it may have been forwarded by hand or forged. It was not imported.
emailImport.rotateText: The old address stops accepting mail immediately — update it in your forwarding settings.
